Instant overview of daily revenue, vehicle throughput, bay utilization percentages, and technician labor efficiency.

Automated daily ledger subtracting operating expenses, chemical product costs (COGS), and staff commissions from settled income.

Role Security

Supervisor PIN & Fraud Shield

Individual 6-digit staff PINs secure all touchpoints. Sensitive actions require manager elevation.

Anti-Leakage Protection

No vehicle enters a wash bay without payment lock. Voids, discounts, and refunds require supervisor PIN approval and are permanently recorded in an immutable audit ledger.
